items: Make TopologyBasis first-class: semantic_epoch + activation_epoch + CognitiveFrame + operation/projection semantics.
Constrain higher-order activation by relation-instance/role identity; pairwise views require query-specific equivalence evidence.
Expose negative-delta/revocation activation receipts plus inhibition/budget/stability metrics.
Use predicted amortized read/write cost rather than a fixed compaction percentage.
Extend CognitiveFrame audit with semantic_epoch/activation_epoch witnesses and mixed-basis counts.
Allow topology/projection epoch witnesses inside OTCC volatile/causal dependency envelope.
Attach TopologyBasis/projection identity to projection and uptake receipts; latent activation remains upstream candidate state, not ignition evidence.
If a persistent activation assembly is nominated as emergent, preregister truthful/shuffled/no-field lesion-rescue and OOD tests; recurrence alone is insufficient.
Integrate HYP-RC3 epoch-pinned compiled topology into EPOCH/CASK kernels without promoting synthetic results.
